content: Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II dwells on imposter Sufis who neglect the Shariʿa and use tricks to gain disciples and influence over rulers, mentions his receiving the khirqa-yi tabarruk from one Sufi before travelling abroad, and dismisses the Hurufi movement of Fażl Allāh Astarābādī in harsh, resentful terms.
